problems.reason: Family assignment differs: one states Oviraptoridae, the other Caenagnathidae.
One claims Microvenator is a primitive sister to all other oviraptorosaurs, while the other places it within the family Oviraptoridae.

notes: - contradiction: "Microvenator is classified within the infraorder Oviraptorosauria and belongs to the family Oviraptoridae." / "The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Microvenator as Caenagnathidae.": Family assignment differs: one states Oviraptoridae, the other Caenagnathidae.

- contradiction: "Microvenator is considered a primitive taxon and may be the sister group to all other oviraptorosaurs." / "Microvenator is classified within the infraorder Oviraptorosauria and belongs to the family Oviraptoridae.": One claims Microvenator is a primitive sister to all other oviraptorosaurs, while the other places it within the family Oviraptoridae.
